data.other_hard: female students; Canadian residents (Canada awards only)
data.evidence_sentence: The CREW Network Foundation scholarship program supports female students as they pursue higher education that will lead to careers in commercial real estate.
data.notes: Page lists several awards: US undergraduate ($5,000) and graduate ($10,000) scholarships, and Canadian awards for Canadian residents ($5,000 CAD undergraduate, $10,000 CAD graduate). Graduate is read as master because no doctoral study is mentioned. Page does not state nationality, GPA, enrollment status, or field of study. Application window is Jan 5 to April 1 with no year, and the text refers to 2026 awards, so the deadline is annual. Funding is a fixed amount for tuition and books, plus a travel stipend for the convention. The page does not give the study location, so host_country is empty.
